articles.headline: Curry scores 44 points as the Warriors hold on to beat the Timberwolves 119-114
articles.description: — Stephen Curry scored a season-high 44 points, rookie Yaxel Lendeborg had 26 and Golden State Warriors held on Wednesday night for a 119-114 victory over the Minnesota Timberwolves, who were without injured guard Anthony Edwards.

articles.headline: Fred VanVleet and Amen Thompson lift undefeated Rockets past Bucks, 132-100
articles.description: — Fred VanVleet scored 24 points and Amen Thompson added 23 as the Houston Rockets remained undefeated with a 132-100 rout of the Milwaukee Bucks on Wednesday night.

articles.headline: Nikola Jokic notches 200th career triple-double as the Nuggets down the Pelicans, 104-91
articles.description: — Nikola Jokic had 21 points, 13 rebounds and 10 assists for his 200th career triple-double in the regular season, and the Denver Nuggets never trailed in a 104-91 victory over the winless New Orleans Pelicans on Wednesday night.
